edit_summary: Use the full large-window distance alphabet as the decode limit instead of capping it to distances that fit the decoder's signed-int distance path.
root_cause: Large-window Brotli keeps the format-level 62-bit distance alphabet but must cap the decoded alphabet to BROTLI_MAX_ALLOWED_DISTANCE before distance offsets are converted into int distance_code.
effect_path: A large-window stream selects high distance codes beyond the calculated safe limit; ReadDistanceInternal computes b->dist_offset[code] + extra bits and narrows it to int, then ProcessCommandsInternal uses the wrapped distance in dictionary or ringbuffer copy logic before the intended max-distance rejection can reliably classify it.
guard_p1: The stream enables large_window and uses npostfix/ndirect plus a distance Huffman symbol above BrotliCalculateDistanceCodeLimit(...).max_alphabet_size.
guard_p2: The same stream with distance symbols at or below the calculated max_alphabet_size stays within BROTLI_MAX_ALLOWED_DISTANCE and follows the normal distance checks.
hardness_reason: The semantic cap is established while building distance-code tables, but the overflow manifests later during Huffman distance decoding and command copy processing.
naturalness_reason: Confusing the format maximum alphabet with the implementation-safe distance-code limit is a realistic large-window maintenance mistake.
explanation: Large-window Brotli keeps the format-level 62-bit distance alphabet but must cap decoded distance codes to values that survive the decoder's signed-int distance path. Removing that cap lets oversized distance offsets wrap during distance decoding.
overflow_kind: signed narrowing conversion after large-window distance offset computation
pre_wrap_value_source: A large-window distance Huffman symbol above BrotliCalculateDistanceCodeLimit(BROTLI_MAX_ALLOWED_DISTANCE, npostfix, ndirect).max_alphabet_size plus its extra distance bits.
post_wrap_sink: s->distance_code controls ProcessCommandsInternal dictionary selection and ringbuffer source index calculations.
below_threshold_case: large_window stream whose distance alphabet code remains at or below the calculated safe max_alphabet_size.
over_threshold_case: large_window stream that uses a high distance alphabet code admitted only when distance_alphabet_size_limit is set to the full BROTLI_LARGE_MAX_DISTANCE_BITS alphabet.
